description: This file defines constants, inline functions, and documentation related to the IPC static vrings backend in Zephyr, focusing on endpoint registration flows and memory sizing calculations.

methods.name: vq_ring_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of a virtqueue ring based on number of descriptors and buffer size.

methods.name: shm_size
methods.description: Calculates the total shared memory size needed for vrings based on number of descriptors and buffer size.

methods.name: optimal_num_desc
methods.description: Determines the optimal number of descriptors based on available memory and buffer size.
